# Rubblebelt Recluse: "This creature attacks each combat if able."
# MANDATE_ATTACK static (Pirate / Furor of the Bitten) over the guide's "this creature" selector.
must_attack = StaticAbility(effect=A(Verb.MANDATE_ATTACK, {
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    ),
}))
abilities = [must_attack, *compiled]

clauses.clause: This creature attacks each combat if able.
